sources.excerpt: The Women's Tennis Association (WTA) announces that its finals will move to Charlotte, North Carolina, United States, from Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, for three years beginning in 2027, with matches at the Spectrum Center.
The WTA also relocates its global headquarters from St. Petersburg, Florida, U.S., to Charlotte.

In September 2026, the health ministry reported Japan had 107,677 people with 100 years old or older, the first time the country surpassed 100,000 people—with 94,298 as being women—since the beginning of the records in 1963
Previous figures exceeded 1,000 in 1981, 10,000 in 1998, 50,000 in 2012 and 95,000 in 2024.
